newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA TIN, NICKEL CONTINUE FALL, COPPER STEADIES.
newsitem.headline: INDIA TIN, NICKEL CONTINUE FALL, COPPER STEADIES.

text.p: Tin and nickel prices extended declines on India markets, but copper steadied on Tuesday, dealers said.
Other base metals held in a narrow range.

Weak wrold markets set the trend for tin and nickel. Tin fell 100 rupees to 28,900 rupees per piece after losing 200 rupees on Monday while nickel dropped 300 rupees to 33,500 rupees per quintal after losing 300 rupees on Monday.
Copper was steady at 13,150 rupees per quintal on stray industrial support. Copper was down by 50 rupees on Monday and by 125 rupees last week.

Meanwhile aluminium was steady at 7,800 rupees per quintal but undercurrent was firm amid expectation that local producers may hike selling prices shortly. Zinc was indicated unchanged at 8,400 rupees per quintal, as was lead at 4,200 rupees per quintal. Nominal trading was registered in both.
